title: How One Nightly Question Keeps a Godly Man's Impulses From Running Him
caption:
Self-control isn't a personality. It's a rep he does before he sleeps.

What ran you today, that you didn't choose? What did you feed first? What would tonight look like running on empty?

He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion (Philippians 1:6). Your job isn't to win the willpower contest alone. It's to show up to the next small thing.

Ask the question tonight. See what it turns up.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #selfcontrol #discipline
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
